steps.npc: I provide items to help you keep your legs!

claiming-corrupted-platelegs-plateskirt.npc: This is just what I needed for my special secret... err... I've said too much! Take this and get out of here quickly!

claiming-corrupted-platelegs-plateskirt.text: Louie quickly takes an acorn and the bones in exchange for some mysterious legwear.

using-al-kharid-flyer-on-louie-legs.player: Hi! I have this money off voucher!

using-al-kharid-flyer-on-louie-legs.npc: So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.

using-al-kharid-flyer-on-louie-legs.player: But I only just got it!

using-al-kharid-flyer-on-louie-legs.npc: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
